Subject: Post-event attribution — FinTechWorks Summit (Nov 17)

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for sponsoring the FinTechWorks Summit on Nov 17. Our finance team just ran a reconciliation and the pipeline we have tied to Redwood for the event is significantly higher than the $62k you reported in the post-event deck.

Can you share the underlying lead export and your mapping logic (HubSpot ID -> RDC attribution rule) so we can check for duplicates or mismatches? I've attached our own leads export and the sponsor report we received from the venue.

Particular asks from our side:
- Full CSV of event leads with HubSpot contact IDs
- Mapping of which events/UTM/QR scans you used to credit leads to Redwood
- Any filters applied (job title, location, duplicate stitching)

We want to reconcile quickly — this affects how we split booth credits across partners for our year-end reporting.

Thanks,

Hi Ellie — really appreciate the heads up.

Quick summary of what we ran on our side (attached):
- Extracted event leads from our booth QR scan list and the dedicated summit landing page (UTM=ftw2026)
- De-duplicated by email (case-insensitive) then merged by matched HubSpot contact ID where available
- Applied a 30-day last-touch window for pipeline crediting per the sponsorship agreement

I'm attaching the internal mapping workbook (internal-hs-mapping-20261201.xlsx) and the lead export we used. Can you confirm whether your export contains HubSpot contact IDs in column C? A common mismatch we've seen is when partners export raw form submissions without the CRM ID attached.

If you can send back the specific contact IDs you believe were misattributed, we'll walk the records together.

Ben

Looping internal team for reconciliation and to propose a mutual action plan with FinTechWorks. Summary of actions we agreed on during quick sync:

1) Ops (Lauren) to run a HubSpot merge audit for the five FTW IDs Ellie flagged and return canonical IDs + merge timestamps (ETA: Mon 12/7).
2) Product (Karthik) to confirm whether our staging-to-prod sync could have dropped last-touch attribution when an imported contact had a later interaction (ETA: Tue 12/8).
3) Sales (Ben) to offer FinTechWorks a joint review session (30 min) to walk records live and agree final crediting; propose Wed 12/9 or Thu 12/10.
4) Finance to hold final sponsor split until both records and mapping are reconciled (Marissa to notify).

We should prepare a consolidated reconciliation note and a redlined summary of any attribution-rule changes for the sponsorship appendix. If this looks right, Ben please propose times to Ellie and include the HubSpot canonical IDs once Lauren completes the audit.

-Marissa
